manuscript_sentence: On the fixed c40 split, the mean FAD - Xception difference across five training runs was -0.0092 AUC. A crossed bootstrap propagating training-run and source-target-component variation produced a 95% interval of [-0.0358, +0.0180]. The Monte Carlo uncertainty band for its upper endpoint was [0.0176, 0.0184], entirely above the +0.014 reference; 4.07% of crossed-bootstrap replicates exceeded that reference. This fixed-split c40 evaluation therefore neither demonstrated a FAD advantage nor excluded a gain of the published magnitude.
